planned_math_to_code.statement: Solve min_y .5||y-yhat||_M^2 + lambda sum_(t,v)||D2 y||_2, with A y=X.
Write y=y_p+S z, A y_p=X, A S=0. Stationarity is S^T M(y_p+S z-yhat)+(D2 S)^T p=0.
